label: Copy-phase update gate: short sequences, and late copy steps fed p/o/h/digits 1-3
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L), where the input is the model's own previously emitted token. It never fires in the original phase or on the delimiter step. Three regimes: (1) L=3 sequences, where it fires on every copy step (precision ~1.0) and the strongest activations occur (e.g. 0 p c <DEL> 0 [p]); (2) L=4 at recall_idx 2 (about 52% precision); (3) longer sequences near the end of the copy (to_go <= 2), when the fed-back input is p, o, h or digits 1-3 (p has the highest rate, about 24%). Magnitude is largest for short L and early recall positions (recall_idx 2 holds 28% of the mass). Token identity alone gives only F1 0.42, so firing on long sequences is diffuse and the fit is incomplete (dev F1 0.54, mass recall 0.73).
